body: Moneybagg Yo admits he sometimes acts happy because he feels he has to stay strong for the people looking up to him 💯🙏 When asked what makes him smile these days, he opened up about how difficult that can be. He explained that being a role model comes with pressure to set an example, especially for the kids watching him. Even though he knows he’s human too, he worries about how seeing him break down would affect them. He says he pushes himself to stay strong for them, even when things get “super intense” and “super hard.” You never really know what someone is carrying behind their smile. ❤️ Via:

Moneybagg Yo admits he sometimes acts happy because he feels he has to stay strong for the people looking up to him 💯🙏

When asked what makes him smile these days, he opened up about how difficult that can be. He explained that being a role model comes with pressure to set an example, especially for the kids watching him.

Even though he knows he’s human too, he worries about how seeing him break down would affect them. He says he pushes himself to stay strong for them, even when things get “super intense” and “super hard.”

You never really know what someone is carrying behind their smile. ❤️
